auditoria.erro: maturity: README never states stability, should be "unknown"; role left empty though README clearly describes it. serve none is defensible (Node in-memory only, no search/MCP role).

final.role: SQLite Wasm wrapped as an ES Module for browsers (OPFS persistence in workers)
final.evidence: SQLite Wasm conveniently wrapped as an ES Module; Node.js is currently only supported for in-memory databases without persistence.

auditoria.nota: SQLite para navegador; no Node não persiste, então não serve ao servidor MCP do hub, que usaria SQLite nativo.
